missing.action: Resolve and document identity status before analogue selection or read-across use.

unresolved.action: Resolve identity before analogue selection or read-across use.

review.action: Document and verify the surrogate or partial identity before use.

other.action: Confirm the identity-resolution status and supporting identifier before use.

unavailable.action: Obtain a valid standardized structure before using structural grouping evidence.

flagged.action: Review reactive features and local chemical environment before shared assessment.

unavailable.action: Obtain a valid standardized structure and re-run structural alert screening.

incomplete.action: Review member-level property ranges when sufficient comparable members are available.

outlier.action: Review flagged property differences before shared assessment.

biological.reason: No endpoint evidence retrieved in Stage 3
biological.action: Retrieve and review endpoint-specific biological evidence; do not infer an endpoint conclusion from grouping alone.

provided.action: Confirm route, duration, device/product context, and exposure assumptions for the intended assessment.

missing.action: Request concentration, route, duration, and intended-use exposure context.
Run or resolve Stage 2 domain evidence before using this grouping for shared assessment.

high.action: Do not use direct read-across; resolve the stated domain limitation or assess separately.

medium.action: Document member-specific differences and toxicologist rationale before shared assessment.

other.action: Confirm the Stage 2 domain status before using this grouping for shared assessment.
